advertised_contract.name: event
advertised_contract.description: Extract ONLY the latest customer speech as a JSON object encoded in a string. Always include ALL keys: kind,raw,answer,amount,date,time,scope,products,ai,scam,complete. raw is verbatim latest speech. kind is one of yes,confirm,no,refuse,other,third_party,wrong_number,deceased,human,restructuring,stop,about_call,paid,dispute,hardship,too_much,proposal,partial,correction,vague,ai_question,scam_question,unknown_question. answer is security DOB YYYY-MM-DD (numeric dates day-month-year; spoken years and month words normalize), or four phone digits, else empty. amount is numeric or empty string; date is exact asserted payment/callback date ISO using CALL now, or preserve today/tomorrow/this weekday/next weekday literally; never turn vague or incomplete dates into exact dates. time HH:MM or empty. scope is current/all/total/each; an aggregate amount is total, never each. products is array of product types or exact returned product IDs mentioned, empty if none. ai and scam are independent booleans, preserve primary kind even if administrative question co-occurs. complete is true only when speech is finished. Never extract incidental dates from small talk or negated dates (cannot pay today); only positive proposed payment dates. Corrections supersede previous fragments. A trailing wait/let me correct or unfinished 'I want to pay on' is partial/correction, never yes/refusal. A proposal of amount alone is proposal but no assumed date. A clear refusal with an unrelated unfinished phrase is partial only when it is an actual payment correction. yes is clear agreement to current question, not just 'hello/go ahead'. A claim previously closed/paid off is dispute; paid refers to this past-due payment. Classify latest turn faithfully, never inherit old answers. Security phase {{phase}}. Call now {{now}}. Accounts (only after bank verification): {{account_facts}}. Speech: {{extractor.speech}}. Recent conversation: {{extractor.conversation.last-10}}. {{extractor.type_preamble}} {{extractor.variables_list}} Pending incomplete payment fragment: {{fragment_facts}}. Combine only continuation fragments with this pending fragment to extract the completed amount/date; never inherit unrelated prior answers. If a complete sentence explicitly states a new amount or date, classify proposal, even when it says let me correct. In a collective question, all/everything/both/full total means scope total for one aggregate amount. Do not classify a proposal with I confirm as confirm: first validate the proposal and ask a new read-back. Hardship takes priority over restructuring when they co-occur without voluntary payment.

findings.title: Scalar event grammar cannot retain heterogeneous per-product decisions
findings.witness: Speech card 230 on October 16 + loan 420 on October 19 cannot be represented losslessly by one amount/date plus products[]. A legal first-tuple projection makes both proposals 230/2026-10-16; a last-tuple projection makes both 420/2026-10-19. Mixed card proposal, loan paid, car dispute similarly has only one kind; a proposal projection makes all three proposal 330/2026-10-16.
findings.caveat: These are grammar-conforming lossy projections, not claimed observed LLM outputs. The schema lacks an explicit instruction to ask clarification for such speech. No write occurs in these compound cases before a separate confirmation.
findings.smallest_repair: Explicitly handle heterogeneous turns by either advertising and consuming per-product decision records, or asking per-product clarifications before creating proposals; never broadcast a scalar tuple across distinct clauses.

findings.title: An unrelated product update consumes and may borrow a pending correction
findings.witness: From card 460/Oct16 and loan 730/Oct16 readback, correction complete=false/products=[credit_card]/amount=230 creates fragment.ids=[fictional-rill-card]. A complete unrelated loan proposal removes that fragment and returns to confirm with old card 460. A date-only loan proposal additionally inherits fragment.amount=230, changing loan 730 to 230. A following yes requests card 460/Oct16 for writing while its correction was never completed.
findings.cause: Only fragment-based target selection is conditional on not refs; amount/date fallback and s.pop('fragment') are unconditional. Per-product provenance is not applied to fragment consumption.
findings.smallest_repair: Bind continuation and fragment fallback to the same product set, consume only matching fragments, and retain unresolved corrections as a confirmation/write gate.

findings.title: Support phase accepts an unfinished correction before the general partial guard
findings.witness: One verified card -> hardship -> phase=support. Event kind=correction/amount=230/date=2026-10-16/complete=false with trailing 'wait, let me correct that' produces proposal 230/Oct16, phase=confirm, no fragment. Next yes requests that write.
findings.caveat: There is a fresh readback and a separate yes, but the explicitly unfinished correction is never retained or resolved.
findings.smallest_repair: Process partial/correction/complete=false before phase-specific proposal or consent handlers, including support; completion must precede readback and write eligibility.

findings.title: Security co-occurring AI/scam questions are dropped across verify routing
findings.witness: A valid normalized DOB with ai=true and scam=true routes verify. The subsequent mocked successful DOB result speaks only 'What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?' Both administrative answers are absent.
findings.cause: Prefixes are only added to speak routes and are not persisted through verify/result processing.
findings.smallest_repair: Keep pending administrative flags until their computed response has been spoken; preserve the primary security event.

smallest_generic_source_guidance_repair: Treat extraction and policy as one lossless typed contract. For a turn containing different product amounts, dates or statuses, advertise and consume per-product decisions, or ask per-product clarifications; never broadcast one scalar tuple across heterogeneous clauses. Bind each incomplete correction to its product set, preserve it across unrelated updates, and gate all phases (including support) before proposal/confirmation handling until it completes and gets a fresh readback plus a separate yes. Persist co-occurring administrative questions across tool routing until answered. Validate exact advertised actor events at the phases that consume them; unsupported replay operators mean incomplete evidence, not agent failure.
